subject: SIG evidence request: SDLC change approvals & CI artifacts
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@assessors.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire follow-up — SDLC change gating evidence

Hi Priyom / team,

Thanks for the initial SIG submission. The assessor team has a follow-up: we need concrete artifacts showing your secure SDLC controls for the last two quarters focused on change control, code review enforcement, CI/CD gating, and secrets scanning. Specifically: 

- A single index (CSV preferred) that maps requirement -> artifact file name / link (examples: PR review sample, pipeline run, change approval record).
- Representative code review samples showing mandatory reviewer count & require-status checks (redact code if needed).
- CI pipeline run logs demonstrating blocked merges on failing security checks (one run per month is fine).
- Evidence of automated secrets scanning and the alert/remediation workflow (scan output + ticket or remediation log).
- Change management audit log showing approvals for emergency and standard changes between 2027-01-01 and 2027-03-31.

Can you bundle these or point to direct links? Also confirm whether any of the artifacts contain customer PII so we can plan secure transfer. Target: evidence pack delivered by EOD 2027-04-14 if possible.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Senior Assessor
AssuranceCo

---
Note: We will accept redacted samples or zipped artifacts. Attach small index file or links first to confirm structure before full upload.

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@assessors.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up — SDLC change gating evidence

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear list.

We can provide an evidence bundle that covers those bullets. Quick notes / plan: 
- I attached a starting index (priyom_sdlc_artifact_index.csv) that maps requested items to filenames and short notes.
- Code review samples will be redacted; we'll include reviewer metadata and PR checks (not full source).
- CI runs: we'll pull one pipeline run per month (Jan–Mar) and include the logs that show test & policy failures when applicable.
- Secrets scanning: we will include a scan output export and a link to the remediation tickets.
- Change approvals: we can export change-approval-log-202702-202704.csv — it contains approver, timestamp, change type (emergency/standard), and ticket reference.

Two quick Qs: 
1) For the change logs, do you need the underlying change diff or just the approval records + ticket links?
2) Any preferred secure transfer method? We have a secure SharePoint/Drive folder and can provide a signed link or upload to an SFTP endpoint.

I’ll loop in Dev for the pipeline logs and Neha for the change export. If that timeline works we’ll aim to deliver the bundle by 2027-04-14 EOD PT.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sr. Product Security Manager
Redwood Inference

[attachment: priyom_sdlc_artifact_index.csv]

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@assessors.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up — SDLC change gating evidence

Hi Maria / team,

Following up with the artifacts we discussed. Summary of what I’m uploading into the evidence folder (links in the index):

- ci_pipeline_run_20270410.log — example successful + failing run showing the pre-merge security gate (policy check step named "security-scan").
- code_review_samples_202703.zip — 3 redacted PRs with reviewer timestamps and CI status badges.
- change-approval-log-202702-202704.csv — exported from our change registry; includes emergency flag and approver chain.

A few implementation notes in case they help during review: 
- Our repo branch protection requires two reviewers for main and enforces status checks; failing checks block merges (the log includes the blocking event).
- Secrets scanning: we use repo-scanner v2.1 in CI. Scans are automated pre-merge; we create a Jira ticket for any findings and set remediation SLA to 5 business days. I included one sample ticket link in the index.
- Sensitive artifacts were redacted to remove identifiers; nothing in the attached files contains customer PII.

For transfer: I uploaded the full bundle to the secure evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSDLCEvidence (access restricted). If you prefer SFTP, let me know and I’ll get an upload credential.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Engineering Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference

[attachments: ci_pipeline_run_20270410.log, code_review_samples_202703.zip, change-approval-log-202702-202704.csv]

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@assessors.co>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Tom Hale <tom.hale@acmefinancial.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire follow-up — SDLC change gating evidence

Thanks — I can access the Drive folder and the index looks good. A couple small follow-ups before we close the item: 

- Could you attach one example of an emergency change where the approval chain was followed (redacted diff ok) — we just need the approval email/ticket and the timestamped approver records.
- Please include the Jira ticket key for the sample secrets finding you referenced so we can review the remediation notes.

If you can drop those two items in the same folder by EOD PT tomorrow we’ll consider this requirement satisfied for SIG. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Maria
Senior Assessor
AssuranceCo
